purpose: Seed a real Chinese-language Bookshop collection after Bible-world resources are separated. Candidates are acquisition inputs only; none become canonical Dawn Works until identity, provenance, rights and admission gates pass.
rules: exclude Bible text and ordinary Bible-study/reference resources from Bookshop counting
prefer full readable works over metadata-only records
preserve source edition and rights evidence
do not equate acquisition with public admission

candidateWorks.title: 靈歷集光
candidateWorks.author: 宋尚節
candidateWorks.rightsEvidence: Project Gutenberg marks the ebook public domain in the USA
candidateWorks.reason: Chinese Christian primary work; biography, testimony, evangelism and 20th-century Chinese church-history value.

sourceQueues.action: Acquire source metadata and available full-text formats; run edition/author identity and jurisdiction-aware rights gate before admission.

sourceQueues.source: Christian Literature Society for China collection (Yale Divinity Library / HKBU)
sourceQueues.rightsBoundary: Collection notice states works published in 1930 or earlier are public domain and downloadable; post-1930 works may remain copyrighted and are not automatically admissible.
excludeOrRouteElsewhere: verse-by-verse/commentary works whose primary function is Bible study -> bible-world-zh/Emmaus planning
post-1930 works without independent reusable-rights clearance
sourceQueues.action: Enumerate pre-1931 downloadable records, classify Bible-world vs Bookshop, normalize title/author/year, then admit only records with clear source and rights evidence.

laterQueue.example: Journal of Research for Christianity in China
laterQueue.rule: Useful as article/publication acquisition, but CC BY-NC-ND material must retain license restrictions and should not be treated as public-domain book stock.

promotionPipeline: optional 光譜/策展集/三晨星 editorial layers
successCriterion: First milestone is not a large count. It is a rights-clean, non-Bible Chinese canonical collection with enough real works to support Bookshop design without fake shelves.
